rule.name: IgnoredTimedWaitInTest
rule.message: This timed wait returns false when the time runs out, and the result is dropped, so the assertions after it run whether or not the work finished: the test fails later with a misleading message, or passes without having checked anything. Assert the result, as in assertTrue(latch.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)), or test it and fail with a message that says what did not happen in time.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //ExpressionStatement/MethodCall[ pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch#await(long,java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.concurrent.locks.Lock#tryLock(long,java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.concurrent.Semaphore#tryAcquire(long,java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.concurrent.Semaphore#tryAcquire(int,long,java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.concurrent.BlockingQueue#offer(_,long,java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.Process#waitFor(long,java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit)') or (pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService#awaitTermination(long,java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit)') and not(ArgumentList/*[1]/descendant-or-self::*[@Name = 'MAX_VALUE']) and not(ancestor::MethodDeclaration[1] [matches(@Name, '^(close|stop|shutdown|destroy|tearDown|cleanup|dispose|after)', 'i') or ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = ('PreDestroy', 'AfterEach', 'AfterAll', 'After', 'AfterClass', 'AfterMethod', 'AfterTest', 'AfterSuite')]]))] [not(*[1][self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('verify', 'when', 'should', 'given', 'expect')]])] [not(ancestor::MethodDeclaration[1]//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('expectLastCall', 'replay', 'replayAll')])] [(parent::ExpressionStatement | parent::ExpressionStatement/parent::Block/parent::TryStatement[not(FinallyClause)]) /following-sibling::*//MethodCall[matches(@MethodName, '^(assert|verify)') or @MethodName = 'fail']]
